## Checklist
- [ ] `uv run pytest -q` passes
- [ ] `uv run ruff check server tests` is clean
- [ ] `uv run mypy` is clean (if you touched the typed core)
- [ ] No personal / environment-specific values (hostnames, usernames, IPs, absolute home paths) — see [CONTRIBUTING](../CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` `[Unreleased]` updated for any user-facing change
- [ ] Docs updated if behavior or configuration changed
